name: read_file
description: Reads a data file (CSV, JSON, or plain text) that was uploaded by the user and returns its contents as a string. Use this when the user has attached a data file and you need to inspect, analyse, or summarise its contents. Always call this tool before drawing any conclusions about uploaded data.

filename.description: The filename returned by the upload response (e.g. 'a1b2c3d4-uuid.csv'). Must not contain path separators or '..'.
